messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER fired: gpupool-eu-central queue growth detected. autoscaler at ceiling for gpupool-eu-central (40). link: https://redwood-infra/ops/incidents/3138889012

Priya: I'm taking lead. High error spike for hosted generation in eu-central, several workspaces seeing timeouts. @Alex @Mateo can you grab infra triage?

Alex: on it. kubectl shows a bunch of pods Pending due to insufficient gpu resources and strict podAntiAffinity.

Alex: ```
$ kubectl get pods -n inference --field-selector=status.phase=Pending
NAME                                  READY STATUS    RESTARTS AGE
inference-worker-9f7a1                0/1   Pending   0        6m
inference-worker-a2b3c                0/1   Pending   4m
... (12 pending)
```

Mateo: cluster-autoscaler events: attempted scale up, hit nodepool maxNodes=40. Preemptible burst pool disabled for this pool. Also see a few dirty nodes preventing fast scheduling.

Li: I'm paged. I can request a temporary cap raise or enable the preemptible burst pool. Which do we want? Need an approver for ephemeral bump.

Priya: quick customer-impact check: tail latency up, a non-zero % of streaming sessions aborted. CS is drafting a notice. Priority: relieve queue pressure ASAP. Propose: 1) temporary maxNodes bump to 60 2) enable preemptible burst for 15m 3) enable low-priority eviction for ML-batch jobs to free GPU slots 4) spill large batch requests to CPU fallback queue.

Zoe: drafting customer bulletin now. Will call out mitigation steps and ETA.

Mateo: I can push routing rule to spill >8-token requests to cpu-fallback queue for non-enterprise tokens. That should cut GPU-bound ingress by ~25%.

Alex: command to update nodepool (GKE):
```bash
gcloud container node-pools update gpupool-eu-central \
  --cluster=eu-central-cluster --region=europe-central2 \
  --max-nodes=60 --project=redwood-prod
```
Also need to flip preemptible burst: patch autoscaler config map.

Li: got verbal approval from infra lead. Executing nodepool update and enabling preemptible burst. Will monitor instantiation. ETA ~10-14m for GPU nodes to join and drivers to initialize.

Li: running update now.

(6m later)

ops-bot: Event: 6 new nodes registered to gpupool-eu-central. GPUs healthy.

Alex: nodes joining, pending pods scheduling. Pending down from 12 -> 5.

Mateo: applied spill routing: POST /v1/edge/spill {"threshold":8, "target":"cpu-fallback", "selector":"!enterprise"} — immediate effect visible in ingress metrics. Backlog decreased ~22%.

Priya: CS note sent. Initial customer replies acknowledge mitigation. Keep monitoring SLOs.

Li: preemptible burst enabled. Eviction policy applied to batch jobs (priorityClass=low-batch). We're seeing batch jobs preempted and GPUs freed.

Alex: watch shows P95 latency coming down and 502s decreasing. Error rate trending toward baseline.

Priya: set a provisional rollback plan: revert maxNodes to 40 and disable burst after 45 minutes if metrics stable for 15m. Li, schedule rollback; Zoe will send follow-up to customers when we rollback.

Li: ack. Scheduling rollback at +45m. Monitoring costs flag — budget guardrail checks OK for emergency bump.

(30m later)

Mateo: metrics stable for 18m+, pending pods 0, error rate near normal. Can we start rolling back?

Li: starting rollback: gcloud container node-pools update gpupool-eu-central --max-nodes=40 --region=europe-central2

Li: rollback initiated. Nodes are cordoned and drained gracefully. Preemptible burst turned off.

ops-bot: Nodes deprovision complete. Node count back to 40.

Alex: scheduling stable, no new pending pods. Spill routing removed and batch eviction policy reverted.

Zoe: customer follow-up sent: mitigation complete, root-cause investigation to follow, postmortem forthcoming.

Priya: quick follow-ups for post-incident: 1) enable preemptible burst as a Canary option for each gpupool 2) relax anti-affinity defaults for inference-worker for short windows 3) add an automated spill rule triggered at 70% GPU utilization to avoid human-in-the-loop cap bumps. Mateo, Li — can you file tickets?

Mateo: will create tickets: CA-config tuning, affinity policy doc, automated spill rule. Assign ETA 1 week for CA, 2 weeks for affinity, 3 weeks for automated spill.

Priya: great. Incident will be recorded as INC-2026-3138889012. I'll keep channel open until tomorrow for any regressions. Thanks all for fast coordination. :tada:
